verification.precondition: A production surveyctl run has issued one SurveyFrame Assignment and a canonical populated text submission exists.
verification.stimulus: Submit through the text CLI, then resolve the retained GenerationRecord, its exact Submission, request, Assignment, and semantic result references from the persisted session.
verification.expectedSemanticState: The retained Submission explicitly reports external unattested and unreported provenance; its attempt and evidence bind the exact request and submitted bytes while GenerationRecord evidence remains outside semantic product identity.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: The test runner reports the literal assertion: surveyctl retains explicit unattested provenance without changing semantic products
verification.forbiddenMutation: The CLI must not invent a provider or model claim, omit request or content binding, place GenerationRecord among semantic products, or let producer telemetry alter semantic identity.

behavior: surveyctl retains explicit unattested provenance without changing semantic products
